audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart marks Akshan winning levels 1-5 and Skill after, while the content layer and packet chart both say Syndra all seven rows, and every phases[N].why describes Syndra winning.
audit.why: Two-layer disagreement renders two answers to the same question; packet levelChart and 51.5% WR support Syndra-favored.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side moved to Syndra; win[0..6] already Syndra so side edited alone per the chart rule; whys rewritten grounded in Akshan's kit.

audit.why: Spikes present: L2 QE, L3 full kit, 6 R execute, Luden's, late. spikes[] has 4 entries with real content.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akshan's Dirty Fighting (P) shield absorbing Syndra's burst was never mentioned (flagged missing interaction). breakdown.cooldowns held no numbers despite the kit giving Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, Avengerang 9-5, Syndra E 15, R 120/100/80.
audit.why: Shield changes all-in maths; cooldown field exists to hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Shield folded into breakdown.early and phases[3]/[5] whys; real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.
Heroic Swing 18s rank 1 / 12s max, Avengerang 9s-5s, Syndra E 15s, R 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim — bodies unrelated to their titles.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to match their titles, grounded in Heroic Swing and Dirty Fighting.

edits.before: Q on every last-hit he takes — your level 1 poke is the best in the mage pool. Leave spheres on the ground; they're ammo.
edits.after: Q every last-hit he takes — Avengerang must fly out and back to match one cast. Leave spheres on the ground; they're ammo.

edits.before: Q-E already threatens the stun — most mids don't respect it at 2 and pay a Flash for the lesson.
edits.after: Q-E already threatens the stun — an Akshan stepping up for passive stacks at 2 pays a Flash for it.

edits.before: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q again is a half-bar rotation. The lane is yours to bully from here.
edits.after: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q is a half-bar rotation, and the stun cancels Heroic Swing mid-air.

edits.before: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking; every sphere thrown is scaling AND pressure at once.
edits.after: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking; chip his passive shield out so his trades stay losing.

edits.before: Unleashed Power online — count spheres before every trade: three-plus on the field means most mids die to R alone.
edits.after: Unleashed Power online — your R is instant while Comeuppance stores bullets standing still; you execute him first.

edits.before: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes squishies. Force the wave contact trades he cannot refuse.
edits.after: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes him before Dirty Fighting's third hit banks a shield.

edits.before: Late Syndra is a one-button court-martial: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict. Spheres on the ground are sentences waiting.
edits.after: Late your AoE stun catches every swing-in and your R deletes him at range — his pick game never reaches your backline.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, 12s max — his only engage and escape; the window after he swings is your window. - Avengerang runs 9s down to 5s — trade while it is flying back. - Your E is 15s: it answers the swing, never buys poke. - R at 120s closes fights.

edits.before: Bully from minute one: Q poke is free, QE is terror, and most lanes concede CS by level 3. Bank splinters and spheres in equal measure.
edits.after: Bully from minute one: Q poke is free and QE is terror. Poke Dirty Fighting's shield out with Q before any commit — burst into it fizzles.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is his only way onto you — a QE line the moment he grapples stuns him out of the air and cancels the dash.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With E down for 15 seconds he swings in for free — chasing past your stun is a duel on his terms into Dirty Fighting's shield.

notes: Fixed the two-layer chart disagreement: full sides said Akshan/Skill while content win[] and the packet chart said Syndra on all 7 rows and every why described Syndra winning. win[N] already read Syndra, so sides were edited alone per the chart rule, with whys rewritten in the same group. Missing interaction (Akshan P shield absorbs burst) folded into breakdown.early. Could not verify from the kit whether QE actually interrupts Heroic Swing mid-swing (knockback vs dash priority) — existing text asserts it in spikes[0] and whys; left as-is rather than remove, but flagged in unverified.
